types.name: Tourist eVisa
types.purpose: Tourism, visiting family and friends, events and Umrah (not Hajj, study or work), applied for online.
types.note: Official eVisa terms: maximum stay 3 months, cannot be extended; passport valid 6 months. Not a work visa.

types.name: Tourist visa on arrival
types.purpose: Tourist visa issued on arrival to eligible nationalities, or to holders of a valid US, UK or Schengen visa.
types.note: Eligibility depends on nationality; check the visa regulations page.

types.name: Tourist visa via Saudi mission
types.purpose: Tourist visa applied for at a Saudi embassy or consulate by nationalities not eligible for the eVisa.
types.note: Stay and validity are set by the mission.

types.name: Transit / stopover visa
types.purpose: Short stop in Saudi Arabia while travelling onward, applied for online.
types.note: MOFA e-service lists transit visas of 48 and 96 hours; one official page differs, confirm before travel.

types.name: Family visit visa
types.purpose: Visit to first-degree relatives (parents, spouse, children) resident in or citizens of Saudi Arabia.
types.who: First-degree relatives of a resident or citizen
types.note: Inviter starts the request. Not valid for Hajj. Inviter must hold a work Iqama.

types.name: Personal visit visa
types.purpose: Visit for people with no business or family relationship to the inviting resident.
types.who: Invitees of a Saudi resident or citizen

types.name: Business visit visa
types.purpose: Visit by professionals who have business relations with a Saudi company or institution that invites them.

types.name: Work visa
types.purpose: Entry visa for people abroad to work in Saudi Arabia, individually or via accredited agents and companies.
types.note: Converted to an Iqama after arrival.

types.name: Resident companion (family) entry visa
types.purpose: Entry visa for companions of residents, requested without visiting the authority.

types.name: Medical treatment visa
types.purpose: Visit to the Kingdom for medical treatment.
types.note: Private hospitals submit a support letter from health affairs.

types.name: Umrah visa
types.purpose: Umrah pilgrimage; travel allowed between Makkah, Madinah and other cities.
types.note: Ministry FAQ gives 90 days of stay (no extension beyond 90) but also a 30-day cap ending 15 Dhu al-Qi'dah, so stay is not set here. Cannot be extended for Hajj.

types.name: Hajj visa
types.purpose: Hajj pilgrimage, for those with approval from the relevant authorities.
types.note: Visit, tourist and work visas do not permit Hajj. Residents need ID or Iqama.

types.name: Residence permit (Iqama)
types.purpose: Residence and work permit issued after arrival on a work or family entry visa.

types.name: Premium Residency (unlimited duration)
types.purpose: Premium residency of unlimited duration for foreigners.
types.who: Foreigners meeting Premium Residency Center criteria

types.name: Premium Residency (special talent)
types.purpose: Premium residency for researchers, healthcare and scientific professionals, and other special talents.

types.name: Premium Residency (investor)
types.purpose: Premium residency for investors with a Ministry of Investment licence.
